Adds cash at strong asset values; potential balance sheet and liquidity boost.
Removes related debt, clarifies net cash from sale.
Funds near-term capex, limiting external financing needs.
Signals reinvestment into newer, efficient tonnage.
Capex and delivery timing inform future capacity and cash needs.

This is a mid-cycle fleet-optimization move, monetizing older tonnage at high values to fund newbuilds. A larger catalyst would be confirmation of additional asset sales, charter rate updates, or financing terms impacting 2027–2029 deliveries.
